svg.title: Lab · full native dependency atlas
svg.desc: All 28 Lab nodes and their exact prerequisite edges, from six source feeds and CALC through CP1, directed review, CP2 and Integrity.
svg.text: 28 native nodes · 98 declared dependencies · arrows point to the consumer
Six feeds plus CALC → seed → seven miners → Cross / Orient / Decide (CP1) → seven directed miners → Cross / Director (CP2).
Integrity consumes both phases. Its 20 prerequisites span two continued panels; nothing is omitted.
Feed content is bound to the issue snapshot by runtime configuration, not by an extra JSON dependency edge.
TOOL: source or deterministic operation REASONING: model operator Green: frozen Lab/Oracle checkpoints
Repeated cards name the same artifact. Each declared edge appears once; no skip edges are omitted.
